# Software Engineering Learning Suite

Purpose: coordinate a professional, evidence-based software engineering program across specialized repositories. Phase 3 provides 156 GUIDED classes for stages A and C; 324 classes remain PLANNED. GUIDED does not claim executable or tested laboratories.

Read first:
- README.md
- STATUS.md
- curriculum.yaml
- catalog.json
- classes/README.md
- FILE_INDEX.md
- PROMPT_MAESTRO.md
- manifest/repositories.json
- docs/PROGRAM-ARCHITECTURE.md
- docs/COVERAGE-MATRIX.md
- docs/INTEGRATION-CONTRACT.md
- docs/REPOSITORY-BOUNDARIES.md
- sources/class-sources.json
- sources/phase3.json
- matrices/COMPETENCY-MAP.md

Rules:
- Respect repository ownership and avoid duplication.
- Verify changing claims in primary or official sources.
- Security, accessibility, testing, observability and recovery are part of done.
- Use pnpm only for JavaScript/TypeScript.
- Do not invent evidence, metrics, laws, APIs or compatibility.
- Treat PLANNED as specification only; require evidence before raising maturity.
- Treat GUIDED as complete teaching guidance, not as executed or tested software.
- Never overwrite an authored class with the scaffold generator.
- Run build_phase2.py --check and build_phase3.py --check before trusting generated counts or site pages.
